name: Red Envelope
description:
THIS OFFERING IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE
A gesture of generosity to bring good fortune to the unfortunate.
Calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
• Spawns 1 Red Envelope per Player.
• The Aura of your Red Envelope is revealed to you at the start of the Trial.
• Interacting with your Red Envelope reveals its Aura to all other Players in the Trial until it is claimed.
• Opening another Player's Red Envelope triggers the Rabbit's Blessing Score Event, which awards a semi-random amount of Bloodpoints.
• When another Player opens your Red Envelope during the Trial, you are awarded Bloodpoints and a Cosmetic from the Moonlight Burrow Collection.
• As Killer, hooking a Survivor onto a Lunar Hook triggers the Lunar Celebration Hook Score Event, which awards bonus Bloodpoints.
• As Survivor, finishing a Lunar Generator triggers the Lunar Celebration Generator Score Event, which awards bonus Bloodpoints.
The bonus Bloodpoints are applied during the Trial.
Red Envelope was only available during the Moonlight Burrow 2023 Lunar Event.
